title: OAG Trust Headers Profile v1.0
description: Optional trust headers profile for the Open Agent Governance Specification. Defines HTTP headers for conveying agent identity and trust metadata in inter-service communication. Conformance level: Optional (MAY implement).

X-OAG-Agent-ID.description: Content-addressable agent identifier (64-char hex BLAKE3 hash)

X-OAG-Verification-Status.description: Current verification status of the agent

X-OAG-Risk-Level.description: Assessed risk level of the agent
